The bank's core operating profit grew by around 29 percent year-on-year despite treasury losses of Rs 1,000 crore. PNB aims to achieve Rs 6,000 crore in net profit in the upcoming quarters due to steady operational performance. Loan growth is being supported by retail, agriculture, and MSME segments during the festive season.

banking-economy.title: Bandhan Fin to explore health insurance foray post stabilisation of recent acquisitions: Chairman Ghosh
banking-economy.summary: Bandhan Financial Services is exploring opportunities in the health insurance sector after recent acquisitions. The company intends to focus on consolidating its existing businesses before expanding further. Recent acquisitions include IDFC Mutual Fund and Aegon Life Insurance, which will need to be streamlined. A parliamentary panel has suggested introducing a composite insurance license for better market penetration. The group is also considering investment banking and wealth management opportunities.

sectors.title: Govt asks Meta to ensure its recommendation systems do not expose users to a limited set of narratives

sectors.title: ‘Dad, the internet at home is too slow’: How Jio’s founding idea took shape
sectors.summary: Isha Ambani's concerns regarding poor household internet sparked important conversations about India's digital landscape, leading to transformative innovations. sectors.title: From shareholders to partners: How Google and Meta’s Jio investments evolved into an AI alliance
sectors.summary: Meta and Google, originally minority shareholders in Jio Platforms, are now forming strategic partnerships with Reliance. The new collaborations focus on enterprise AI initiatives and dedicated cloud infrastructure in India. Meta's joint venture will leverage Llama models for developing AI platforms, while Google focuses on establishing cloud services. Both companies aim to enhance Reliance's capabilities in AI and cloud technology sectors.
